questions.subject: DISCRETE_MATHEMATICS_II
questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: What does Lagrange theorem say about finite group subgroups?
questions.explanation: Lagrange's theorem states that the order of any subgroup divides the order of the finite group. It does not require the group to be abelian or force subgroup orders to be prime.
questions.hint: Think about cosets partitioning the group.
